_comment: Wording the order documents (lib/agreementPdf.js) quote for what a purchase includes. The three sentences per product are the published product facts on the catalogue page (public/agents.html PRODUCT_FACTS); tests/order-documents.test.mjs fails when they drift, so the confirmation PDF never promises more than the catalogue does. Changing a promise means changing both, with the claims-truth review that the catalogue gets.

licensor.support: Support by e-mail (hello@colleagueai.ai) with your order reference.
licensor.securityReporting: Security reports: hello@colleagueai.ai. A dedicated security contact and the public vulnerability-disclosure page will be announced to licensees when published.

contract-intelligence-and-register.includes: A perpetual, single-tenant licence to this release (1.0.3.6), the versioned release package with its SHA-256 checksum, the install guide and readiness checklist, and corrective releases for defects in this release at no further licence fee. Support by e-mail (hello@colleagueai.ai) with your order reference.
contract-intelligence-and-register.excludes: Microsoft licences or Copilot Studio capacity, installation or configuration done for you, new feature releases, scanned-document OCR, languages other than English, and Continuous Certification (not yet open).
contract-intelligence-and-register.delivery: One managed Microsoft Power Platform solution (1 Copilot Studio agent, 7 Power Automate flows, 4 Dataverse tables, 1 read-only security role) plus the install guide. You download the package after purchase and import it into your own environment. ColleagueAI never connects to your tenant.
